column1: # writers.tsv (harbor#978 item 8) — every script that CREATES a named thing, and the command patterns that find them.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. A writer that builds a branch, issue title or PR title by hand is a second copy of the
# grammar, and it drifts while reading correctly. `bin/lint-renderer.sh` (rule name.renderer-used) holds each
# `writer` row to calling the renderer (`lint-name.sh --render`), and scans bin/ and hooks/ for the `pattern`
# rows so a writer missing from this census is itself a finding. Workload writers are registered by their pack.
# COLUMNS  id <TAB> kind <TAB> value <TAB> surface <TAB> note
#   kind     writer (value: a repo-relative file) or pattern (value: an ERE a creating command line matches)
#   surface  the surface in surfaces.tsv the written name is judged as
